items.claim: [r42-1] test-seams' header promises seams it no longer exports
items.note: (no longer applies). The header now names the stroke-marker and content-handler resets, points to `@weasel-js/paint-kinds/test-seams` for the paint-kind reset, and describes path edit's dep source and stub. All of those are exported.

items.claim: [r42-2] mesh.ts claims a `sideEffects` entry that core's package.json lacks
[r42-3] `ops.swap` is history's value swap, not a core op
items.note: (no longer applies). The package doc now says `ops.swap` is `@weasel-js/history`'s `createSwapOp`, never touches the scene, and that swapping two nodes is editing's `swap` command.

items.claim: [r42-4] engine.ts header says it carries "the actions and tools such a host binds"
items.note: (no longer applies). The header and its generator in `scripts/gen-engine-entry.mjs` now say the actions a host binds are `@weasel-js/editing`'s.

items.claim: [r42-5] the `@weasel-js/core/ops` example commits through an API that does not exist
items.note: (no longer applies). `commitOps(deps, ops, label)` exists and core's main entry exports it through `barrel/paths.ts`, so the example matches its signature.

items.claim: [r42-6] test-seams exports the same fixtures under two names each
items.note: I kept `gridSnapSourceForTests`, `snapSessionDepForTests`, `pbtRunsForTests`, `pbtTallyForTests` and `pbtTimeoutForTests`, and dropped `gridSourceForTests`, `sessionDepForTests`, `runsForTests`, `tallyForTests` and `timeoutForForTests`. I renamed the 9 editing tests that imported the dropped names and updated the exports inventory. The new `test-seams.test.ts` checks that no value is exported twice; it failed before the fix. None of the dropped names was ever in a released changelog, so this needed no new changeset; I edited the pending one that announced them.
